reviews.title: A worthwhile upgrade from an already excellent Insta360 Link.
reviews.comment: Excellent Camera, and a discernible upgrade from the Insta360 Link, which is also very good.  Works better at Lower light but better performance and clarity, and I use it for a podcast camera, mounted inside an Elgato Teleprompter.  It seems the heat management is improved, despite never having a problem with overheating.  The clarity is pretty astounding and the auto stabilization is outstanding!
reviews.author: The Good Doctor!

reviews.title: GREAT！！
reviews.comment: I’m a longtime 360 user, and when the latest model launched, I ordered it immediately. Dropping $250 stung at first, but it’s absolutely worth it. The AI tracking is incredibly smart, keeping me in frame even when I move around or grab coffee. The new sensor handles low light really well, making my dim home office look much better on camera. The tracking area feature is a huge plus—my messy kitchen finally stays off-camera. Pricey, but the performance fully justifies it.
reviews.author: Maggie

reviews.title: Great upgrade for the price
reviews.comment: Super easy to install and has great camera quality. The tracking function is also helpful during a presentation. The only negative is that the cord to plug into the computer is quite short. It would be helpful to have a longer cord out of the box for a little more versatility.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Get the Pro! Worth the price.
reviews.comment: This is an amazing, professional web camera. So glad I got the Pro! Filters, adjustments, tracking are all great. The sound quality is better than my external yeti mic. Worth the cost.
reviews.author: BGold

reviews.title: worth every penny
reviews.comment: crisp image, the pan and tilt is super responsive, and the app is easy to use. I use it everywhere a webcam is used: teams, discord, WhatsApp, slack, etc and looks sharp every time. it has stayed on top of the monitor very secure, the attachment is heavy and of great quality.
reviews.author: David Lay
